title: Kid Howard's and Henry Allen's band personnel
summary: Walters names the players in Howard's and Allen's bands: Prudence, Big Yank, Big Fire, Edward Johnson, Albert Martin, Lil Dad, with the interviewers sorting out the Johnsons.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: To back up and get some of these different guys' names and instruments. Johnny Prudence was playing with Kit Howard, you say?
That's right.
And what did he play?
He was a string bass player.
And do you remember any of the other guys with Howard?
Well that time we had Big Yank, trombone player. And Yank left to go with Allen. And he got Big Fire in the Yanks' place.
Big?
Big Fire.
Big Fire, who was he? He was a trombone player,
he used to run up and down the coast, they had cut off in them places.
I don't know him. No. Well we'll ask Howard about him.
Oh he had a double of a name around there.
And clarinet, did you have a clarinet or sax? No they had a clarinet,
I think Georgia Lutz was playing with Kit Howard then.
And let's see, who else would be in the band? Drums and banjo I guess maybe.
There was a fellow by the name of Son Thomas was playing banjo with him. He has passed too. I just remember the drummer.
And let's see, after Howard you went with Henry Allen. Went with Henry Allen. That's the young son. The young son, yeah.
Well I played with the Fallen in later years, in the brass band. But I was playing piano then, and I went with Allen during that time.
And who was over there?
With Allen? Yeah. Well they had, I was on piano, Edward Johnson on alto sax, Albert Martin on drum, Big Fire on trombone, and Lil Dad on banjo.
And which Johnson was this on sax? Edward Johnson.
Is that Big Head?
No, the other one, the little bright one. I can't keep those guys straight, there's so many of them.
One is Eddie and one is Edward.
Oh I see. Well Noon is Edward Johnson too, you know. And that's Noon's real name, you know. That really does get confused in there. And then you joined the Camellia you say with Wooden Joe?
